messages:
emma: kicking off staged rollout v4.1.0 -> canary 6% (us-west). change window 11:00-13:00 PT. release notes at https://redwood/release/v4.1.0 :rocket:

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-3999 started. targets: canary=6% us-west. monitors: p95_latency, 502_rate, semantic-regression. logs: /rollouts/r-3999. :robot_face:

zack: quick smoke: unit & integration green on canary pods. starting a small A/B on 3 nodes for long-horizon prompts.

infra-bot: notice: nodepool-c showing 2 pod restarts in 6m; kube events point to kernel oom_kill on model-worker. tagging nodepool-c.

emma: seeing p95 jump on canary slice from 120ms -> 260ms coincident with those restarts. sample logs below.

zack: logs:
```
[11:07:12] model-worker node-12 oom_kill pid=9876 mem=93%
[11:07:13] proxy node-12 conn_reset req=aa1 status=502
[11:07:14] reranker: score_drop avg=0.65 baseline=0.82
```

ops_lead: recommend pause ramp, pin rollout at 6%, and run targeted eval. also ask infra if a kernel/pagecache tweak could address oom_kills — but prefer rollback if quality impacted.

deploy-bot: pin command: `deploy-bot pin r-3999 --reason "oom_kill nodepool-c + p95 spike"` -> done. state=paused_at_6pct. audit: emma at 3999999052.

infra-bot: infra note: we have a kernel vm.min_free_kbytes tweak that reduced OOMs in staging last week; can try a single-node experiment in canary, but it requires node recycle.

zack: can we run the kernel tweak on one canary node and A/B it? might be faster than rollback, but riskier for quality.

emma: prefer evaluation first. queue eval on critical-set and long-tail. if eval fails, rollback. if eval passes and infra tweak stabilizes restarts without quality hit, we can unpin.

eval-bot: queued ev-2100 with prompt_set=critical+longtail. ETA ~7m.

ops_lead: rollback playbook ready: `deploy-bot rollback r-3999 --to v4.0.9 --notify cs-team@redwood` if ev-2100 fails or 502s continue >1% for 10m.

eval-bot: ev-2100 complete. results: critical pass_rate=90% baseline=96% delta=-6pp (flagged). longtail pass_rate=92% baseline=94% delta=-2pp. report: https://redwood/evals/ev-2100

zack: regression on critical set exceeds threshold. I'm leaning rollback. infra tweak can be attempted after we stabilize.

emma: agree. CS on standby. prepare rollback note.

cs-team: drafted notice: "We paused v4.1.0 canary in us-west due to quality regression and intermittent node restarts; reverting to v4.0.9 while we investigate."

emma: deploy-bot, please run rollback now and include audit tag.

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-3999 --to v4.0.9 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "critical-set quality regression + oom_kill"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic reverted to v4.0.9. state=rolled_back. audit: rollback by emma at 3999999123.

infra-bot: created remediation ticket INF-1412 to test vm.min_free_kbytes tweak in a dedicated staging cluster and validate memory usage under v4.1.0. will not roll tweak to canary until ML-ops signoff.

ops_lead: post-rollback checklist: archive failing prompts from ev-2100, reproduce locally with debug logs, vet kernel tweak in staging, and run full eval before reattempting v4.1.0. schedule triage at 15:30 PT.

emma: thanks all. closing roll for now. will reopen when patch + infra tweak validated. :white_check_mark:
